reference.source: Psychiatry topic map (Marrow e6 topic selection only; text rewritten in own words, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Functional diagnosis uses positive signs (Hoover), not normal tests alone
Somatic symptom disorder can coexist with real disease
Factitious on another is safeguarding emergency
reference.pathophysiology: Stress and attention amplify symptom perception through predictive brain processing, while dissociation compartmentalises traumatic memory and identity; functional symptoms reflect reversible network dysfunction without structural lesion.
additionalDifferentials: Functional weakness versus stroke (positive signs, pattern)
Somatic symptom versus undiagnosed disease (red flag vigilance)
Dissociative amnesia versus dementia (autobiographical, abrupt, trauma)
additionalInvestigations: Focused examination for positive functional signs
Video EEG for dissociative seizures when indicated
Limited targeted investigations by red flags, collateral and safeguarding where relevant
